visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Rows Have an Even Number of Stars
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The pyramid rows should have 1, 3 and 5 stars, but they have 2, 4 and 6 so the shape is lopsided.

solution.explanation: The widths of a centered pyramid are the odd numbers 1, 3, 5, which is 2 * i - 1. Using 2 * i gives even widths, which can never be centered on a single star.
